decisionsTitle: The concurrency suite reads the calendar too: `yarn test:clock --concurrency`
decisionsSection:
**What happened.** The sweep of `fix/test-clock-time-bombs` kept `tests/concurrency/` read-only and found one bomb there: `capacity.test.ts` submitted the restart-door registrations at the real `new Date()` against a fixture race at `2026-12-01T09:00Z`. On 1 December the suite goes red, and CI's `e2e` job runs it (shard 1) as a required check on `qa` and `main`, so it would have blocked every release from that morning.

**Decision.** The fixture event of `capacity.test.ts` starts 60 days after the real clock instead of on a written date, so the case that must submit at real time (the seeded privacy notice is effective from the day it was seeded) is always before the start. Every capacity assertion is unchanged. The suite's other written dates never meet the real clock; they were proved by running, not by reading: `yarn test:clock --concurrency` runs `tests/concurrency/` serially with the Node clock moved (`vitest.concurrency.config.mts` loads `tests/helpers/shifted-clock.mjs` while `TEST_CLOCK_AT` is set), and it ran green at +2 months, +1 year, +10 years and 2031-06-01 after the fix (red at +2 months, +1 year and +10 years before it). The database server's own `now()` stays real, which is why a fixture there derives its dates from `Date.now()`.

**The clock tools' nits.** `+1m` and `+1y` from the 31st (or 29 February) spilled into the month after; they now stop at the target month's last day.

**Refused.** Moving the fixture to a later written date (a bomb with a later fuse), and any change under `src/`.
changelogLine: - **The concurrency suite no longer fails on 1 December** — its fixture race starts 60 days after the real clock, `yarn test:clock --concurrency` runs that suite at moved dates, and `+1m` from the 31st stays in the month. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: `yarn test:clock --concurrency` runs the two-connection suite with the clock moved and it passes at +2 months, +1 year and +10 years; a month ahead of the 31st is the last day of the next month (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the concurrency suite is calendar-proof, and test:clock reaches it
